question: Which native retained-target and copied discovery design preserves comment identity, history and document-level access without scaling per-anchor work with replacement depth?
method: Task design; Best API hard-cut and pre-acceptance scale gate; Plite/Plate ownership; matched disposable source transforms and independent ordinary-owner challenge
trigger: User requested $task design plan comments attachment correctness and document-level discovery after the September 18 attachment review.
requirements: Keep published conversations and original excerpts when targets disappear; document history must not rewind replies or resolution.
Only current exact-view attachment may paint text or count on a block; no historical/clamped block placement.

Deletion followed by unrelated later typing stays unavailable, including separately completed updates in one undo batch; intentional atomic replacement inherits removed target identity and preserves range direction.
All published open/resolved and available/unavailable conversations remain reachable without restoring a sidebar, mode switch, provider or second semantic store.
Preserve comments-only installation, exact independent views, optional-plugin independence, existing async mutation guarantees and historical-preview target identity.
Accept no native runtime replacement until cold, changed-state, anchor-count times lineage-depth and retention costs pass a frozen executable comparison.
evidenceReuse: Reused matching September 18 diagnosis, completed persistence contracts and limited earlier Google Docs observation. Inspected current native authored bindings, ordinary range/history recovery, Comments snapshot/attachment APIs, copied card/controller/toolbars and explicit demo consumers. Executed disposable source transforms only; independent challenge exposed ordinary boundary replacement and both history mapping sites. No new cloud/browser interaction or product edits. During recording, the Task review-history adapter changed. Re-read it: it adds explicit reconciliation and plan metadata; the technical decisions and product source are unchanged.
summary: Specify retained-content succession and one lazy All comments dialog, but defer the coupled native runtime. Cut remembered block placement, the always-mounted unavailable spill, duplicate demo feeds and the card targetUnavailable override. Reuse current Comments records/subscriptions and existing registry item; keep Floating Discussion and comments-only install. Reject two authored provenance-on-read candidates: trial2 passes30/30 behavior probes but repeats ancestry per binding and costs628–706ms for10k targets across100 replacements versus90–96ms baseline. The ordinary correction passes12/12 but narrowly misses its frozen relative gate. A prepared authored-binding update handoff is the next design experiment, not an accepted architecture.
alternatives: Keep stale block placement, configure a flag or move missing targets to the nearest block: reject; none represents current attachment.
Delete the Comments package or place conversation lifecycle in document/Authored history: reject; durable replies/resolution and comments without suggestions have independent jobs.
Add a tombstone/history plugin, targetUnavailable lifecycle, provider or public list controller: reject; duplicates existing native identity or semantic records.
Cut every retained range with deletion:drop: reject; loses exact ordinary undo and replacement behavior.

Infer succession recursively from authored contribution provenance on every resolve: rejected by two measured candidates; correct selected semantics do not justify target-count times replacement-depth work.
Cache final ranges by projection to improve warm reads: insufficient; changed-state combined cohorts remain the acceptance surface, and cross-view/persistence correctness cannot be hidden.

Reuse ordinary canonical replacement sections for range-level mapping: concrete private owner path across regular/deferred/stored recovery, but source trial2 narrowly fails its relative gate and fragmented-map scaling is unmeasured.

Prepared native binding updates through existing commit mapping: next disposable experiment; missing accepted/projected before-after/provenance/abort-publication handoff is identified. Ordinary numeric recovery alone does not preserve cross-view/saved-origin identity. Not accepted without a faithful prototype.

One lazy All comments dialog in existing comment-toolbar-button with stable semantic IDs and20-card pages: supported projection design; remove stale spill and duplicate lists, private view-specific target rows, protect dirty/pending inputs. Mounted UI/provider/browser proof remains execution work.
proofLimits: Planning remains gated, not execution-ready. No product source, public API, registry output or public documentation was changed. UI projection12/12 rows is a JS calculation/subscription model, not mounted React or browser evidence. Native trial2 has30/30 correctness against11/30 baseline and six interleaved38-cohort packets; two combined stress arms have only five diagnostic samples each, so report ranges/deterministic work rather than a strong tail estimate. Ordinary12/12 vs4/12 correction narrowly misses10k relative p95 budget34.50ms vs limit34.31ms; fragmented map is unmeasured. Ten final native packets verify316–322 runtime file hashes each without mismatch. The next prepared-binding handoff is a concrete unimplemented design gate, including rollback/history/projection/save/release obligations. Prior Google Docs observation did not replay ordinary comment deletion, boundary replacement or full history. Existing production receipts remain historical, not corrected-contract proof.

reconciliation.question: What should own comment placement and discovery after all target text is deleted, without losing conversation history or attaching to unrelated later text?
reconciliation.reason: Retain independent conversation/native identity, current-view-only placement and document discovery. The causal probes settle richer replacement semantics but reject runtime candidates on scale, so detailed native adoption is deferred rather than approved.

reconciliation.question: Mounted-view attachment authority and completed persistence proof
reconciliation.reason: Keep exact-view native target ownership and published conversation history independence. Prior implementation/browser receipts do not prove the corrected delete/type or boundary-replacement expectations; they remain historical evidence.
